campuses.title: Paralimni Campus
campuses.text: Единственный кампус Xenion — High School и Boarding School в Paralimni (Famagusta District). Спортивные залы, лаборатории, STEAME-студия, новый Boarding House.

paragraphs: Xenion High School is a private K-12 school in Paralimni, Cyprus, established in 2001. It functions under the supervision of the Cyprus Ministry of Education and Culture in accordance with the Private Schools Act, 1971, and is notably the only private school in the Famagusta district. The school combines the best of the Cypriot and British primary curricula and progresses students through Gymnasium, IGCSE and A-Level qualifications.

In November 2011 the British Council named Xenion High School students the 'Best Performing Learners in Cyprus' in the June 2011 examination series — a hallmark of the school's academic reputation. Xenion's motto is 'Knowledge is freedom and power'.

Xenion operates a flagship STEAME Programme (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, Mathematics, Entrepreneurship) — an interdisciplinary track preparing students for top UK, EU and US universities. Faculty includes approximately 120 staff led by Principal Katelitsa Zouvani Phylactou.

Xenion Boarding School welcomes international students from across Europe, the CIS, the Middle East and Asia. The new Boarding House on the Paralimni campus offers full-boarding with en-suite rooms, supervised study, structured daily routines and a year-round activities programme — an English-language pathway to UK and EU higher education in a safe Mediterranean setting.
paragraphsRu: Xenion High School — частная K-12 школа в Paralimni, Кипр, основана в 2001. Работает под надзором Министерства образования и культуры Кипра по Private Schools Act, 1971, и является единственной частной школой района Famagusta. Школа сочетает лучшее из кипрской и британской программ начальной школы, далее ведёт через Gymnasium, IGCSE и A-Level.

В ноябре 2011 British Council назвал учеников Xenion High School 'Best Performing Learners in Cyprus' по результатам June 2011 examination series — визитная карточка академической репутации школы. Девиз Xenion — 'Knowledge is freedom and power'.

Xenion реализует флагманскую STEAME Programme (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, Mathematics, Entrepreneurship) — interdisciplinary track для поступления в топовые университеты UK, EU и US. Преподавательский состав — около 120 человек под руководством principal Katelitsa Zouvani Phylactou.

Xenion Boarding School принимает международных студентов из Европы, СНГ, Ближнего Востока и Азии. Новый Boarding House на территории Paralimni campus предлагает full-boarding с en-suite комнатами, supervised study, чёткой ежедневной структурой и круглогодичной activities programme — англоязычный pathway в UK и EU higher education в безопасной средиземноморской среде.
